attempts.url: no OpenAPI 3.x; Azure publishes its data-plane APIs as Swagger 2.0 in Azure/azure-rest-api-specs

notes: Full coverage of the Azure Blob Storage data-plane API (api-version 2021-12-02, the current stable version in Azure/azure-rest-api-specs), converted from Microsoft's own Swagger 2.0 document committed verbatim as upstream.json — 69 operations and 56 component schemas: service properties/stats, containers, leases, block/append/page blobs, blocks, pages, snapshots, copy, tiers, tags, immutability and legal hold. Replaces a 5 KiB hand-authored spec. Two Azure Swagger extensions are normalised on the way through: x-ms-paths (operations that differ only by query string, which plain OpenAPI paths cannot key) merge into paths with the ? rendered as a # fragment, and x-ms-parameterized-host becomes a templated server with a {url} variable, since the account name is part of the hostname. Blob is the only Azure Storage service the adaptor speaks (uploadBlob, downloadBlob, getBlobProperties — all present); Queue, Table and File are separate services with their own specs.
